declarations.state_ownership: Owns cs_intents, cs_tools, cs_eval_cases, cs_customer_memory, cs_ai_replies, cs_action_log (migration 0051), cs_ai_replies.completed_at (0099), cs_crisis_holding_replies (0104, kind column 0107), cs_conversation_staff_replies (0108) and the unique Chatwoot accountId per organization (0079), all in lobster-factory/packages/db/migrations and reached only through lib/cs/db.ts (header :1-3). The knowledge-base tables cs_knowledge_sources / chunks / folders (0051, 0072-0089) are the knowledge base's, touched through lib/kb. Conversations and messages stay in Chatwoot; per-tenant configuration lives in organizations.metadata.client_config (lib/cs/cis.ts:1-3); Chatwoot tokens are in the secret vault per organization (lib/cs/chatwoot-client.ts:50-62).
declarations.behavior_ownership: Answering customer messages from the Chatwoot AgentBot webhook: claim the message, system-mode gate, free FAQ, credit reservation, AI pipeline, delivery (app/api/webhooks/chatwoot/route.ts:179-274); pipeline lib/cs/orchestrator.ts (handleInbound :62-99); autonomy, red lines and safety in autonomy.ts, tools.ts, guardrails.ts; eval and graduation in eval.ts, graduation.ts; crisis pages in crisis-alert.ts; unfinished-claim sweep in sweep.ts; daily Chatwoot account baseline chatwoot-baseline.ts run as schedule job cs_chatwoot_baseline (lib/schedules/jobs.ts:53-67).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: Inbound HTTP: POST /api/webhooks/chatwoot with a per-organization ?token= secret (chatwoot/route.ts:85-91); POST /api/internal/cs/sweep with Bearer CS_SWEEP_TOKEN (app/api/internal/cs/sweep/route.ts:15-20), called every 5 minutes by the Trigger task cs-inbound-sweep (packages/workflows/src/trigger/cs-inbound-sweep.ts:24-26); staff routes /api/ops/clients/[slug]/{cs-config, cs-config/chatwoot-token, cs-intents, cs-eval-cases, cis, cs-knowledge, cs-knowledge-folders} and /api/ops/cs/eval. Library surface lib/cs/index.ts:9-12. The registry door API is /api/ops/cs (lib/portal/products.ts); the /api/ops/clients/[slug]/cs-* routes are not a prefix a door can own (ADR 017 step 8). Outbound: Chatwoot Account API (chatwoot-client.ts), Anthropic and Gemini (lib/cs/llm.ts:25, :76), OpenAI embeddings through lib/kb (lib/kb/rag.ts:41), operator Telegram.
declarations.invariants: One claim per Chatwoot message (unique organization_id + chatwoot_message_id, migration 0051; claimMessage lib/cs/db.ts:534); a redelivery returns deduped (chatwoot/route.ts:145-146). completed_at is set only after the outcome reached Chatwoot (chatwoot/route.ts:22-30, 0099). Money limits are code constants, not configuration: MAX_REFUND_CENTS = 0 (lib/cs/config.ts:4, :148). handleInbound never throws; any failure becomes a recorded handoff (orchestrator.ts:94-98). The AI stays silent while staff replied publicly in the last 30 minutes (config.ts:134, 0108). At most one holding reply per conversation and kind per 30-minute window (config.ts:125, 0104, 0107). An unknown account and a bad token get the same 401 (chatwoot/route.ts:77-91). Each AI call asks its own feature and passes the grant to lib/cs/llm.ts (:30, :80): cs.answer (generate.ts:36, :80, :132), cs.intent (intent.ts:37), cs.eval (eval.ts:41), cs.translate (orchestrator.ts:305); starting an intent exam asks cs.exam (app/api/ops/cs/eval/route.ts:56).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (tables above; credits charged per model call under the cs.* grants, lib/ai/log-ai-call.ts), chatwoot (lobster-factory/infra/chatwoot/docker-compose.yml), the host cron (poke.sh cs_inbound_sweep; poke.sh schedules_run_due drives cs_chatwoot_baseline, lib/schedules/jobs.ts:9, :53), Anthropic with Gemini failover (llm.ts:1-3), OpenAI embeddings for knowledge retrieval (lib/kb/rag.ts:41), the knowledge base lib/kb and the system-modes gate in the same app (chatwoot/route.ts:15, :211). products.ts dependsOn is empty. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row cs.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: Every db function degrades to empty or no-op and never throws (lib/cs/db.ts:1-3); a claim database error returns 502 and goes to Sentry (chatwoot/route.ts:147-151). Billing fails open: a lookup or rpc error, or an organization without a billing row, lets the message through unmetered (billing.ts:49-53). A blocking system mode hands off with no AI call and no credit (chatwoot/route.ts:205-220). If staff activity cannot be read it counts as active and the AI stays silent (chatwoot/route.ts:412-419). Claims unfinished after 10 minutes go to a human and the AI is never re-run (lib/cs/sweep.ts:5, :13). The sweep task makes one attempt per tick and skips when its token is unset (cs-inbound-sweep.ts:27-34).
declarations.data_lifecycle: Every cs table has organization_id with ON DELETE CASCADE (0051, 0104, 0108). cs_customer_memory.expires_at is filtered at read (lib/cs/db.ts:360-366); no code deletes expired rows and no code writes cs_customer_memory at all (grep: only the select at db.ts:360). No retention job exists for cs_ai_replies, cs_conversation_staff_replies or holding-reply rows; code deletes only eval cases, intents and holding-reply claims (lib/cs/db.ts). recordAction (db.ts:470) and registerTool (tools.ts:16) have no callers, so cs_action_log is not written today.
declarations.observability_contract: cs_ai_replies keeps one row per AI turn with intent, confidence, retrieval score, action, chunk ids and model (0051; orchestrator.ts:46-60); every Claude call is metered through logAiCall (llm.ts:43-48); Sentry receives claim failures, unrecorded staff replies, failed holding replies and undelivered pages (chatwoot/route.ts:103, :148, :339, :347, :367); crisis and threat pages go to the operator Telegram (crisis-alert.ts:1-6); the sweep route returns 502/500 so a failure fails the Trigger run (cs/sweep/route.ts:26-31).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: 0079, 0099, 0104, 0107 and 0108 ship a .down.sql beside the forward file; 0051 has lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts/0051_cs_core_down.sql (drops all eight 0051 tables) and the knowledge-base migrations 0072, 0075, 0076, 0083-0089 have *_down.sql there too. Down files are run by hand (the forward runner skips them, 0107_cs_holding_reply_kinds.down.sql:2-3); 0107's down deletes threat-window rows and 0108's loses staff-reply times (0107_cs_holding_reply_kinds.down.sql:4-5, 0108_cs_conversation_staff_replies.down.sql:4).
declarations.replacement_strategy: lib/cs/index.ts is the only public surface, kept so the engine can be extracted as a service (index.ts:1-3). Chatwoot sits behind lib/cs/chatwoot-client.ts (outbound) and app/api/webhooks/chatwoot/route.ts (inbound); replacing it means a new client and webhook adapter. LLM failover lives in llm.ts; billing changes only the rpc name when 0066 is generalised (billing.ts:9-10).

acceptance.expect: 只產生一筆回覆紀錄與一則回覆，第二次標記為重複

acceptance.test: a customer writes while staff replied publicly in the last 30 minutes
acceptance.expect: AI 不回覆，對話留給真人客服

configuration.apiKeys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (GEMINI_API_KEY as failover, lib/cs/llm.ts:25, :76), OPENAI_API_KEY for knowledge retrieval (lib/kb/rag.ts:41). Messenger / LINE channel authorisations live in Chatwoot; the Chatwoot webhook secret and API tokens are stored per organization in the secret vault, not in env (lib/cs/chatwoot-client.ts:50-62).
configuration.generatedByInstall: CS_SWEEP_TOKEN (app/api/internal/cs/sweep/route.ts:16; the host cron's poke.sh reads the same value from /root/lobster-phase1/.env)
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names the service this product calls; the installer installs that entry's whole compose file (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
